claims: "UFC Freedom 250" is scheduled on the White House South Lawn in Washington, D.C.
The main event of "UFC Freedom 250" is Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje for the Lightweight title.
The co-main event of "UFC Freedom 250" is Alex Pereira vs. Ciryl Gane for the Interim Heavyweight title.
"UFC Freedom 250" includes Sean O'Malley vs. Aiemann Zahabi.
"UFC Freedom 250" includes Mauricio Ruffy vs. Michael Chandler.
"UFC Freedom 250" includes Bo Nickal vs. Kyle Daukaus.
UFC is covering all costs for "UFC Freedom 250".
Restoration of the South Lawn is estimated between $700,000 and $1 million.
No public tickets are available for "UFC Freedom 250".
"UFC Freedom 250" will be overseen by the Association of Boxing Commissions (ABC).
Dana White noted potential issues with the June date for "UFC Freedom 250", including high temperatures in D.C.
Former champion Jon Jones reportedly tried to secure a spot on the "UFC Freedom 250" card but was unsuccessful.
President Donald Trump was the first sitting president to attend a UFC event.
